import os, subprocess, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
for name, mode in [('prefetch', '1'), ('control', '0')]:
    root=Path('build/0.50-code-pages-'+name).resolve()
    root.mkdir()
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env['GNEISS_LOOP_TRACE']=str(root/'engine.csv')
    exe=Path('build/windows-clang-release/bin/gneiss_main_loop_response.exe').resolve()
    hashes={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [exe,exe.parent/'gneiss_engine.dll',Path('build/0.50-page-prefetch.exe')]}
    with (root/'console.log').open('w') as log, (root/'observer.log').open('w') as observer_log:
        process=subprocess.Popen([str(exe),str(root/'result.json'),'--trace','--assets','D:/sunday/workspace/asset-cache/intel-sponza/0.44-full-cooked'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        observer=subprocess.Popen([str(Path('build/0.50-page-prefetch.exe').resolve()),str(process.pid),str(root/'pages.csv'),mode],stderr=observer_log,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
        try:
            result=process.wait(timeout=1000)
            observed=observer.wait(timeout=30)
        finally:
            for child in (process,observer):
                if child.poll() is None: child.kill(); child.wait()
    (root/'run.json').write_text(json.dumps({'fixture_exit':result,'observer_exit':observed,'hashes':hashes,'mode':name},indent=2)+'\n')
    subprocess.run(['python','-X','utf8','-B','scripts/performance/correlate_loop_response.py',str(root/'engine.csv'),str(root/'result.json.probes.csv'),'--output',str(root/'correlation.json')],check=True)
    print(name,(root/'result.json').read_text(),flush=True)
